spine: 1. Rosner 主張多數 app 需要的是 record set 而不是 entity object；ActiveRecord 式的 entity-per-row 抽象因此對他來說是多付的成本。
2. 具體代價：ActiveRecord 程式碼庫本身約 43KLoC、掛著數百個 instance/class 方法，且沒有 window function／CTE／RETURNING 的 DSL 支援。
3. 他借用外部說法「the Vietnam of computer science」形容 row-to-object 映射是一種 anti-pattern。
4. 替代方案是 per-domain store class（如 PostsStore）：方法直接回傳 Ruby hash，SQL 明寫；他主張這個 store 應該是「the interface」。
5. 具體優化例證：naive 版本用 .each(&:delete) 對每列各發一次 DELETE，他自己稱為 N+1；store 版本用 RETURNING 把找列與刪列併成一次 query。
6. 他自估一張表大概只需要一打左右查詢，並反問為何要為此扛一整套 DSL；但也承認 visual query builder 這類需要動態拼查詢條件的例外。
7. 他提到正在做、尚未定案的 statement cache，以及 Extralite 的 structured transform；並主張 time series/event log/KV/job queue 這類非 entity 資料天生更適合 record-set 思維。

perspective.mechanism: 作者展示了兩個具體機制：per-domain store class 把 SQL 與回傳的 hash 收在同一個方法裡；以及用 RETURNING 把「找出符合條件的列」與「刪除並取得其內容」合併成一次資料庫往返，取代 loop 裡逐筆呼叫造成的 N+1。
perspective.tradeoff: 省下的是 ORM 這層抽象的重量（依賴大小、隱藏的方法表面）與 SQL 的可見度；付出的是每個查詢要自己手寫，對需要動態拼查詢條件的場景（他自己承認的 visual query builder 例外）沒有現成 DSL 可用。
perspective.reader_use: 工程師評估要不要為一個新 domain 手寫 store class 時，可以先數一數這個 domain 大概有多少種不同查詢；如果數得完（作者估計一打上下），這篇提供了一個可以照抄的方法命名方式與 RETURNING 寫法。

notes.quote: the ORM layer itself is a substantial dependency (the ActiveRecord codebase is about ~43KLoC), it imposes a performance cost in terms of memory and CPU time
notes.interpretation: 作者以程式碼行數量化 ActiveRecord 這層抽象的重量，並主張這帶來效能成本；記憶體/CPU 成本這句沒有附上具體 benchmark，是他自己的論斷而非量測結果。

notes.quote: ActiveRecord provides the wrong abstraction for relational data. ActiveRecord concentrates on the single record, the idea that each record is an entity in and of itself... ActiveRecord's API revolves around the idea of a separate object for each row, descended from ActiveRecord::Base, with its hundreds of instance and class methods
notes.interpretation: 作者主張 entity-per-row 的物件模型跟大多數 app 實際需要的「一整批 record」不合，並用方法數量之多來強調這層物件表面的重量。

notes.quote: its defining feature, the mapping of rows to objects, is an anti-pattern that has been described as the Vietnam of computer science
notes.interpretation: 作者借用外部說法（連到 Coding Horror 的舊文）加強論點，這個比喻不是他自己發明的，是引用。

notes.quote: we issue one SELECT query to get the beads we're interested in, and then for each post we'll issue a DELETE query, so we got a N+1 situation. beads.each(&:delete) # <== a separate DELETE query for each bead
notes.interpretation: 作者自己給的具體程式碼示範，用來說明 entity-oriented 的使用習慣（逐筆呼叫 delete）如何製造出 N+1，且他自己使用了「N+1」這個字眼。

notes.quote: delete from beads where material = ? returning *;
notes.interpretation: 用 RETURNING 把「找出符合條件的列」與「刪除並取得其內容」合併成一次資料庫往返，是作者提出的具體替代寫法。

notes.quote: Let's retake the example of a simple blog app, and imagine we had an interface that's custom-made for dealing with posts: / The store class should function as the interface for interacting with posts. / posts = PostsStore.new(db); id = posts.create(title: 'foo', body: 'bar'); post = posts.by_id(id); posts.update_by_id(id, title: 'FOO'); posts.delete_by_id(id); posts.all; posts.all_by_category(category: 'baz')
notes.interpretation: 作者提出的具體設計提案：一個 domain 一個 store class，把所有跟該資料表的互動收斂到這一個介面裡，方法對應到 create/by_id/update_by_id/delete_by_id/all/all_by_category 六種操作。前半段用「imagine」這個字，是他自己搭建的示範情境，不是既有產品。

notes.quote: Your app might want to bring in some associations, it might want to be able to filter and sort posts in different ways, so it's going have to make a few other queries, but their number would average, I'd guess a rough estimate, maybe a dozen different queries per table. That, unless you're building a full-featured visual query builder app! So I think the question that should be asked is: if we only need to make a few dozen different queries, why should we use a DSL in the first place?
notes.interpretation: 作者明確承認「一打左右查詢」是粗估（I'd guess a rough estimate），不是量測值；他也明確承認例外情境（visual query builder app）不適用這個估計，這時動態 DSL 才划算。

notes.quote: I've been working recently on automatic caching of statements at the database level, such that any query that's issued with parameters is stored in a cache, and automatically reused whenever the same SQL is given to Database#query.
notes.interpretation: 這是作者自己正在做、用「I've been working recently on」這種進行式描述的工作，不是已經上線或定案的功能。

notes.quote: Extralite can transform projections of joined rows... effectively converting a result set into an object graph
notes.interpretation: 作者藉此說明「不用 ORM」不代表放棄所有結構化轉換能力，Extralite 這個 SQLite gem 本身就提供把 join 結果轉成巢狀物件的宣告式工具（structured transform）。

notes.quote: There's time series data and event logs. Nowadays relational databases are even used as key-value stores and job queues. For these types of data, we're frequently interested in record sets rather than individual records, and we don't really need the entity abstraction. For those uses, ActiveRecord seems clumsy and wasteful.
notes.interpretation: 作者點名幾種資料庫常被拿來做的非典型 entity 用途，主張這些場景本來就不需要 entity 抽象，並直接形容 ActiveRecord 在這些用法上「clumsy and wasteful」。

notes.quote: there's no support for features such as window functions, common table expressions (CTEs), or even the RETURNING clause
notes.interpretation: 作者主張常見 ORM 的 DSL 沒把資料庫真正進階的功能（window function、CTE、RETURNING）納入，逼你要嘛繞過 DSL 寫 raw SQL、要嘛整層放棄；這是對「ORM 的 DSL」的一般化描述，非針對某個版本的量測。

notes.quote: I've always been interested in the design of ORMs - I wanted to know how they work, what the different approaches are, and how they can be used. ... in the last few years I've been slowly gravitating toward working more directly with databases ... in my opinion those abstractions have a way of crumbling under their own weight
notes.interpretation: 作者明確把整篇文章定位成個人立場與經驗轉變的敘述（「I've always been interested」「gravitating toward」「in my opinion」），不是團隊或產業共識。

notes.quote: Ruby is hella fast nowadays, and it's only getting faster and better. now it's our turn to get rid of wasteful and unneeded abstractions, and engage again in writing faster, leaner, better software.
notes.interpretation: 作者的結論帶有明顯個人主張色彩（「our turn」「engage again」），是一篇工程師個人部落格的論戰式收尾，非中立評測結論。

notes.quote: As far as I could tell, there's no API for this kind of query in ActiveRecord. But all we need is a just a way to run a plain SQL query, which should be easy using Extralite:
notes.interpretation: 作者自己用「as far as I could tell」這個弱化語氣，承認他沒有把握 ActiveRecord 真的完全沒有對應 API；他也沒有指名任何具體方法（如 find_by_sql），只是說「需要一個能跑純 SQL 的方式」。本文原先寫的 find_by_sql 是本文自己補的具體名稱，不是原文用語，Step 7.6 c20 已修正為不指名。
